title: Hoagy Carmichael in Terre Haute
summary: He tells of walking into a club where Hoagy Carmichael was casually playing piano.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. Hoagie Carmichael. He is from Terre Haute, Indiana. It's his home. And I was appearing at one of the nightclubs there. And a funny incident happened. And after we finished our show, we went over to the club where he happened to be in. He wasn't playing there, but he was in there. And we didn't know it. And we walked in. There was an Augusta playing. And a piano player playing there. And just regular music was going. And people were just talking and drinking and dancing. And we weren't paying any attention. So somebody at the next table. So somebody at the next table, I heard him say to someone else, who's that playing that piano up there? And somebody very casual said, oh, that's homie Carmichael. Just like he was nobody.
